text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is finally here, and that means another chance at sharpening one's skills!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That being said, with Haru Urara as easily distractible as ever, I worry about the progress we'll make…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Who knows how it'll go, but the blazing summer is about to begin!
